device: Lenovo TB128FU, BOE HX83102P / Himax HX83102E

touch_fifo_diagnostic.scope: one bounded diagnostic, not a guaranteed report rate

gpu.scope: pixel readback and actual desktop operation, no claim of all hardware/video/Vulkan stability

startup.method: Phosh startup tracker interval; not a repeated cold-cache benchmark
startup.scope: user confirmed broad improvement; not a promise that every application launches in one second

reboot_scope: Final GPU/touch survived actual full reboot; later GTK private-library change was validated by full desktop-session restart, not another full reboot

display_resume.scope: Counters are separate sysfs reads, not atomic snapshots. Idle zero reads are not touch points. User confirmed sliding after physical wake retest. No full-device reboot was repeated for this module.
failed_approaches: sense-on relying on native ESD timing
treating idle zero FIFO as corruption
display_resume.software_test_limitation: wl_output removal/re-add is not equivalent to physical power-key blanking and did not test password unlock; historical software test disabled after stale Phosh lockscreen/monitor state was observed

password_unlock_followup.symptom: password check followed by stale swipe lockscreen while ScreenSaver inactive
password_unlock_followup.recovery: recreate the desktop session, retaining password authentication
password_unlock_followup.scope: No Phosh binary patch, full-device reboot, external monitor or long-term suspend validation.
